pages.title: 3.5 Milestones and Decisions
bulletPoints: The project team is faced with a limited number of large impact decisions during the creation process. The decision in general engage the organization with a commitment somewhere in the future. For example:

Ordering of long lead items where changes in specification or design might obsolete ordered items. Re-ordering will cause project delay. Using the initially ordered items might decrease system performance.
Ordering of expensive materials where changes in plan, specification or design might obsolete the ordered materials. Product announcement can not be reversed once the outside world has seen the
announcement. Note that announcing a new product often impacts the order intake of existing products. Announcing a new product late might cause competitive risks.

throughout the entire system, from roadmap and requirement to implementation and verification. On top of this consistency the integrity in time must be ensured. An enabling factor for an optimal result is simplicity of all technical aspects.
